# goschema

> A zero-dependency Go library for JSON Schema generation and validation via struct tags.

## Summary

`goschema` lets you annotate Go structs with `schema:""` tags to define JSON Schema constraints. The library provides:
- **Runtime validation** (`Validate`, `ParseJSON`) of structs, slices, maps, and primitives
- **JSON Schema emission** (`ToJSONSchema`) for draft-07 compatible maps/bytes
- **Auto-defaults**: `ParseJSON[T]` fills zero-value fields from `default=` tags before validating
- **Unified errors**: All errors (JSON syntax, type mismatch, constraint violation) return `ValidationErrors`

## Package

```
import "github.com/twoojoo/goschema/schema"
```

## Key Types

- `ValidationErrors []ValidationError` — list of all violations; implements `error` and `json.Marshaler`
- `ValidationError { Field, Message string; Value any }` — single violation with dot-separated path
- `FieldSchema` — internal resolved schema for one field (not normally used directly)
- `ObjectSchema` — internal resolved schema for a struct (not normally used directly)

## Public API

```go
// Validation
schema.Validate(v any) error
schema.MustValidate(v any)

// JSON parse + validate
schema.ParseJSON[T any](data []byte) (T, error)
schema.ValidateJSON[T any](data []byte) error
schema.MustParseJSON[T any](data []byte) T
schema.MustValidateJSON[T any](data []byte)

// JSON Schema generation (any Go type: struct, slice, map, primitive)
schema.ToJSONSchema[T any]() (map[string]any, error)
schema.ToJSONSchemaIndent[T any](prefix, indent string) ([]byte, error)
schema.MustToJSONSchemaIndent[T any](prefix, indent string) []byte
```

## Tag Syntax

Tags are comma-separated `key=value` pairs on the `schema:""` tag:

```go
Name  string `json:"name"  schema:"required,minLength=2,maxLength=50"`
Email string `json:"email" schema:"required,format=email"`
Age   int    `json:"age"   schema:"minimum=0,maximum=120"`
Role  string `json:"role"  schema:"enum=admin|editor|viewer,default=viewer"`
```

Use a blank `_ any` field for struct-level metadata:
```go
type T struct {
    _ any `schema:"title=T,description=...,additionalProperties=false"`
}
```

## Constraints Summary

| Category | Tags |
|---|---|
| String | `required`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, `format`, `enum`, `const`, `default` |
| Numeric | `minimum`, `maximum`, `exclusiveMinimum`, `exclusiveMaximum`, `multipleOf`, `const`, `default` |
| Boolean | `const`, `default` |
| Array | `required`, `minItems`, `maxItems`, `uniqueItems`, `items:*` |
| Map | `required`, `minProperties`, `maxProperties` |
| Object | `title`, `description`, `additionalProperties`, `dependentRequired:A=B\|C` |
| Composition | `anyOf`, `oneOf`, `allOf`, `not`, `nullable` |

Built-in formats: `email`, `uri`, `date`, `time`, `date-time`, `uuid`, `ipv4`, `ipv6`
